groups.detail: code 381; permitted [501]
groups.spec: rfc3977 3.1 ("The arguments MUST NOT exceed 497 octets": the client's obligation; the server's answer to 498-508 octets of arguments inside a 512-octet line is not stated)
groups.decision: Layer D: refuse arguments past 497 octets with 501, or accept any line within 512 octets. fn1 accepts (AUTHINFO USER of 495 octets: 500 octets of arguments, 381).

groups.detail: code 501; permitted [411]
groups.spec: rfc3977 9.8 (newsgroup-name admits UTF-8) against rfc5536 3.1.4 (component-char is ASCII; specs/article-fields.md:77-78: fn's group names are exactly that grammar)
groups.decision: Layer D: a name RFC 3977 admits that no RFC 5536 group can carry: 411 (no such group) or 501 (fn1).

groups.detail: code 436; permitted [439]
groups.spec: rfc4644 2.5.2 (a TAKETHIS article is answered 239/439 with its Message-ID); H2d-24/28/33/35/45 recorded the class by exact article bytes
groups.decision: None: fn1's known TAKETHIS 436-without-Message-ID class, widened from exact articles to any article with this reply (the class is the reply, not the generated article).

groups.detail: code 501; permitted [335, 435, 436]
groups.spec: rfc3977 9.8 (message-id = "<" 1*248A-NOTGT ">") against rfc5536 3.1.3 (dot-atom-text on both sides of @)
groups.decision: Layer D: an offered ID RFC 3977 admits and RFC 5536 does not (`<a@b.>`): offer outcome (model) or 501 (fn1).

groups.detail: code 436; permitted [437]
groups.spec: rfc3977 6.3.2 / 8.3 (436 try again later, 437 rejected): neither names octets that cannot be an article (NUL, bare LF)
groups.decision: Layer D: an IHAVE article with NUL or bare LF octets: 437 rejected (model) or 436 not received (fn1, which invites a retry that will fail the same way).
